eligibility.open: Every student can apply for this scheme.

list.title: Scholarship applications
list.subtitle: Applications, documents to check and decisions.
list.subtitleYear: Applications for {{year}}: documents to check, what families still have to give, and decisions.
list.search: Search by student, admission no. or application no.
list.emptyHint: Use “Who can apply” to find the students who match a scheme and start their applications in one go.
list.noSchemesHint: Add a scheme first: what it gives, who can apply and which documents families give.

stat.familySub: Something still to give, fix or show
stat.portalSub: Government applications waiting for the institution

tell.button: Tell the family what is pending

approveBenefit.FEE_WAIVER: It is taken off the fees that are still to be paid, and the family is told.
approveBenefit.PAID_TO_STUDENT: The family is told it is approved. The money goes to the student’s bank account.
approveBenefit.PAID_TO_INSTITUTION: The family is told it is approved. Their fees stay held — no late fee, no reminder — until the money comes and you record it.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this application?
withdraw.label: Why is it withdrawn?
withdraw.approvedLabel: Why is it withdrawn? The fee concession it gave is taken back from fees still to be paid.

app.subtitle: Scholarship application
app.needsFixNote: A document needs fixing. Tell the family — they get one message with only what to fix and why.
app.readyNote: Every required document is correct. It is ready for a decision.
app.inProgressNote: {{correct}} of {{total}} required documents are correct so far.
app.feesHeld: Fees held: no late fee, no reminder for this part
app.noDocuments: This scheme asks for no documents.

approvedBenefit.FEE_WAIVER: Approved by {{by}}. It is taken off the fees still to be paid (Fees › Concessions shows it).
approvedBenefit.PAID_TO_STUDENT: Approved by {{by}}. The money is paid into the student’s bank account.
approvedBenefit.PAID_TO_INSTITUTION: Approved by {{by}}. The money comes to the institution later; the fees stay held until it is recorded.

doc.paperCopy: Paper copy kept in the office
doc.paperSaved: Marked as received — it waits to be checked.
doc.markedFix: Marked to fix. Tell the family when you have checked everything.

checkDoc.validFor_one: Good for {{count}} month from this day — the system asks for a new one after that.
checkDoc.validFor_other: Good for {{count}} months from this day — the system asks for a new one after that.
checkDoc.reasonHint: The family is told this, so they know exactly what to do.

new.title: New scholarship application
new.incomeHint: As written on the income certificate.
new.marksHint: Only needed when the results are not in the system.
new.notEligible: This student can’t apply — see the checks below.
new.nothingToGive: Nothing — every document is already with us.
new.holdNote: While it is decided, no late fee is charged and reminders leave this amount out.
new.tellFamily: Send the family the list of documents still needed

who.title: Who can apply
who.search: Search by name or admission no.
who.hint: These students match the scheme and haven’t applied this year. Pick them and start their applications — each family gets only the list of documents still needed. Income is checked on the certificate.
who.emptyHint: Every student who matches has applied, or no one matches the scheme.
who.capped: Only the first 500 students are shown — pick a class to see the rest.
who.renewHint: Last year’s scholars who are still here. Their checked documents carry over, so most only give a new income certificate. Those who do not meet the renewal rule are shown in red.

schemes.title: Scholarship schemes
schemes.subtitle: What each scholarship gives, who can apply and the documents families give.
schemes.subtitleYear: What each scholarship gives, who can apply, the documents families give — and how much is used in {{year}}.
schemes.name: Scheme
schemes.deleteMessage: Nobody has applied for it yet, so it can be deleted.
schemes.emptyHint: Add the scholarships you run or help with — merit, need-based, government schemes, trust scholarships.

form.subtitle: Say up front who can apply and which documents to give, so families come once — or not at all.
form.aboutHint: Its name and who gives it.
form.descriptionHint: A line or two in plain words: what it is and who it is for.
form.whoHint: The system checks these before anyone queues. Leave a part empty to let everyone in.
form.maxIncome: Family income up to (₹ a year)
form.minMarksHint: Taken from the latest published results.
form.documentsHint: The checklist families see. A document already checked for this student — and still good — is not asked for again.
form.docNote: Note for the family, e.g. issued by the tehsildar
form.originalNeeded: Original to be seen at the office
form.originalsNote: Families only bring originals once every copy has been checked online — one short visit.
form.decidedHint: Fewer signatures: one approver at most, and a whole list can be approved at once.
form.rankByHint: When seats are limited, a list is approved from the top.
form.lastDateHint: Families are told this in the message.
form.holdFees: Hold the fees while it is decided
form.holdFeesHint: No late fee on this year’s fees and reminders leave the expected amount out. If it is not approved, late fee starts again from that day — never back-dated.
form.familySees: What the family is asked for
form.familySeesHint: Families get this list — only the documents not already with us.
form.howItWorks: Office staff or class teachers start applications, check each document online and send back only what is wrong. When every required document is correct, the application is approved on its own or waits for the approver.
form.familyApply: Families can apply from the school app
form.familyApplyHint: Off: only the office or a class teacher starts applications for this scheme.

givesHint.FEE_WAIVER: Taken off the fees. A yearly amount is spread over the installments still to be paid.
givesHint.PAID_TO_STUDENT: Paid by the giver into the student’s bank account. The fees are not changed.
givesHint.PAID_TO_INSTITUTION: The government or trust pays the institution later. The fees stay held until the money is recorded, then it is a receipt against the fees.

form.portalHint: Where families apply and the institution verifies. The office keeps each student’s portal number and status here.
form.verifyByHint: The portal’s last day for the institution’s verification.
form.renewHint: Next year, last year’s scholars stay in if they meet this. Leave empty for no rule.

state.SUBMITTED: Sent — the school is checking it
state.ORIGINAL_DUE: Correct — show the original at the school
state.EXPIRED: Expired — please send a new one

next.GIVE_DOCS: Please send the documents below. Take a clear photo of each one — no need to come to the school.
next.FIX_DOCS: The school could not accept a document. See why below and send only that one again.
next.WAIT_CHECK: Thank you. The school is checking what you sent. You will get a message if anything needs fixing.
next.SHOW_ORIGINALS: Every copy is correct. Book a time below and bring only the originals listed.
next.WAIT_DECISION: Every document is correct. The school will tell you the decision.

family.issuedOn: Date it was issued (on the certificate)
family.dateFirst: Enter the date first — this certificate is asked for again once it is a year old.
family.tooBig: That file is too big. Please send one up to {{max}} MB.
family.bookTitle: Book a time to show the originals
family.bookHint: Bring only: {{list}}. It takes a few minutes — no waiting in line.
family.noTimes: The school has not opened any times yet. You will get a message when you can book.
family.incomeHint: As written on the income certificate.
family.noneHint: When the school opens a scholarship this child can apply for, it shows here.

visit.title: Visit times for originals
visit.subtitle: Days the office sees originals. Families book a time in the app once every copy is checked — they come once, and do not queue.
visit.slotHint: A time is offered every so many minutes.
visit.perSlotHint: How many families one desk sees together.
visit.deleteMessage: Nobody has booked it, so it can be deleted.
visit.emptyHint: Add a day when the office can see originals. Families with every copy checked can then book a time.
visit.deskHint: Scan the QR on the family’s phone (or open the row) and press “All originals seen” — a couple of minutes for each family.

portalStatus.FORWARDED: Sent on to the district / university

portal.status: Where it stands on the portal
portal.applicationIdHint: As shown on the portal (e.g. the NSP application id).
portal.sanctionedHint: Once sanctioned, this becomes what the scholarship is worth.
portal.manyHint: Every picked application gets this status — e.g. after verifying a batch on the portal.

money.hint: Each amount becomes a fee receipt (Scholarship money) against that student’s fees, and goes into Accounts like any receipt.
money.referenceHint: e.g. the treasury or bank transfer number.
money.final: Nothing more will come for these students
money.finalHint: Stops holding their fees even if less than expected came.
money.stillAwaited: {{got}} received so far; {{left}} still to come. The fees stay held until then.

report.title: Beneficiaries & money
report.subtitle: Who got a scholarship, and the money given, received and awaited.
report.subtitleYear: {{year}}: who got a scholarship, and the money given, received and still awaited.
